result.summary: The page is mostly intact, but the search field contains a visible spelling error and the favorite control styling is inconsistent between cards.

issues.description: Search placeholder text reads 'Restarants, dishes, groceries' — 'Restaurants' is misspelled as 'Restarants'.
issues.suggestion: Correct the placeholder to 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries'.

issues.description: The favorite heart on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a bare white outline, while the heart on the card below sits inside a dark circular button, so the two controls look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Use the same heart button treatment (icon plus circular background) on every restaurant card.
